instruction:
A Stratix IV FPGA contains a Time-Series Database (TSDB) block that is used for storing and retrieving time-series data. The TSDB block takes in various inputs, including an offset value, a clock signal, a clear signal, and a feedback control signal from the core. It also has several outputs, including a time-series data calibration value, a done signal, a time-series data comparison output, and an offset output. 

You have been tasked with creating a module for the TSDB block that takes in these inputs and produces the appropriate outputs. Specifically, your module should take in a 6-bit offset value, an 8-bit test input, a clock signal, a clear signal, a feedback control signal, and a comparison output test signal. It should output an 8-bit time-series data calibration value, a done signal, a time-series data comparison output, and a 6-bit offset output. 

Your module should also include several parameters, including a calibration temperature value, clock divider enable/disable, clock divider value, a simulated time-series data calibration value, and a user offset enable/disable. 

Write a Verilog module that implements the TSDB block with the specified inputs, outputs, and parameters.
